Ct Mason decreased its stake in Tc Pipelines Lp (TCP) by 6.35% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ct Mason sold 7,910 shares as the company’s stock declined 34.01% with the market. The institutional investor held 116,740 shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.20 million, down from 124,650 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ct Mason who had been investing in Tc Pipelines Lp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $2.47 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.67% or $0.23 during the last trading session, reaching $34.57. About 133,755 shares traded. TC PipeLines, LP (NYSE:TCP) has declined 41.45% since April 30, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 53.00% the S&P500.
